Pure research task in the DeliveryHub frontend repo at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label (React + Vite + Tailwind, JSX). Do NOT modify any files — just report findings with exact file paths, line numbers, and the surrounding code snippet. ## Context This is a white-label delivery platform where a restaurant owner's account has a `type_id` pointing to `establishment_types` (Restaurante / Farmácia / Material de Construção / any future type). There's already a hook `src/hooks/useTipoRestaurante.js` that returns a boolean (`true` if the establishment's type is literally "Restaurante", `false` otherwise), and one existing example of conditional terminology in `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js` — it relabels the "Motoboys" nav link to "Entregadores" when `tipoRestaurante` is false, with the comment: "Estabelecimento tipo ≠ Restaurante (farmácia, material de construção...) chama o entregador de 'Entregadores' no menu, em vez de 'Motoboys'". The user tested logging in as a Farmácia-type establishment and found the UI still says restaurant-specific things everywhere. I need to fix this broadly. Two renames are needed when `tipoRestaurante` is false: 1. **"Cozinha" → "Embalagem"** (and the whole kitchen-prep flow terminology): the "Painel da Cozinha" screen and its status labels change meaning — "Aguardando Preparo" → "Aguardando Embalagem", "Em Preparo" / "Iniciar Preparo" → "Embalando" / "Iniciar Embalagem", "Pronto" → "Pacote pronto". This is the SAME functional flow (order confirmed → prep stage → ready stage → motoboy called), just relabeled — no behavior changes, no removing the kitchen/prep screen itself, just its display text. 2. **"Restaurante" (as visible UI text, not code identifiers)** → **"Estabelecimento"** — e.g. "Restaurante FECHADO", "Painel da Cozinha" (site name context), any header/title/label that literally shows the word "Restaurante" to the user. 3. **"Cardápio digital" → "Catálogo digital"** (also food-specific wording that doesn't fit farmácia/material de construção). ## What to find and report Search the whole `src/` tree (pages, components, config) for: A. Every UI-facing (JSX text content, not variable/prop/component names) occurrence of the literal word "Restaurante" or "restaurante" that a user would actually SEE on screen — e.g. `

Painel da Cozinha

` type titles, "Restaurante FECHADO" status text, button labels, placeholders, empty-state messages, page titles passed to ``. For each hit, show: file path, line number, the exact string, and 3-5 lines of surrounding context. **Do NOT include**: component names like `RestauranteHeader`/`RestauranteSidebar`, route paths like `/restaurante/...`, variable/prop names like `restauranteNome`/`restaurantId`, CSS classes, or internal comments — only what literally renders as visible text. B. Every occurrence of "Cozinha"/"cozinha" as visible UI text (page titles, nav labels, status labels, button text, empty states, alt text) — across `restaurante-cozinha/index.jsx` specifically (the main kitchen screen) AND anywhere else it might appear as a cross-reference (e.g. does `restaurante-producao`, `restaurante-dashboard`, `restaurante-financeiro`, `restaurante-relatorios` ever say "Cozinha" or "enviado pra cozinha" as user-facing text?). Also check `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js` for how the "Cozinha" nav link entry is defined (label/path/icon) — I already know `DELIVERY_LINKS`/`COMPARTILHADO_LINKS`/`SALAO_LINKS` exist there, show the exact block containing "Cozinha". C. The exact status-label objects that map `confirmed`→"Aguardando Preparo", `preparing`→"Em Preparo"/"Iniciar Preparo", `ready`→"Pronto" — I know from prior work this session that AT LEAST these files have such maps: `restaurante-cozinha/index.jsx` (was removed in a recent refactor — check if any STATUS_INFO-like map still exists there for delivery cards), `src/components/restaurante/PedidoDeliveryCard.jsx` (has `BUCKET_INFO` with aguardando/preparando/pronto labels), `src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/PedidoDetalhe.jsx` (STATUS_LABEL/STATUS_COLORS with pending/confirmed/preparing/ready...), `src/pages/restaurante-pedidos/index.jsx`, `src/pages/restaurante-delivery/index.jsx`, `src/pages/restaurante-dashboard/RelatorioPanel.jsx`, `src/pages/restaurante-financeiro/index.jsx`. For EACH of these, show the exact object/map definition with line numbers, so I know precisely which "Aguardando Preparo"/"Em Preparo"/"Pronto" strings exist and need a tipoRestaurante-conditional variant. D. Find "Cardápio Digital" / "Cardápio digital" as visible text — likely in `restauranteNavLinks.js` (BASE_LINKS has `{ label: 'Cardápio Digital', path: '/restaurante/cardapio-digital', ... }`) and possibly in the actual `cardapio-digital` page itself or `RestauranteHeader`/`MobileMenu`/`RestauranteSidebar`. Show each occurrence with file/line. E. Confirm exactly how `useTipoRestaurante()` is currently imported and used (which files already import it) — I want to know which screens ALREADY have access to this boolean and which don't (so I know where I'll need to add a new import + hook call). F. Check `restaurante-cozinha/index.jsx` header area (~line 440-470 based on recent edits) for the literal page title "Painel da Cozinha" and the sidebar/header active-link icon usage — show exact current text. Report everything as a clean, organized list grouped by category (A-F), each entry with file path + line number + exact snippet. This is investigation only — I will do the actual editing myself in a later step.

Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
